description: This file contains logging definitions for the ActivationRepartitioner class within the Orleans.Runtime.Placement.Repartitioning namespace. It defines multiple partial methods decorated with LoggerMessage attributes, used to log various debug, trace, and warning messages related to the exchange protocol during activation repartitioning.

classes.name: ActivationRepartitioner
classes.description: Partial class responsible for activation repartitioning, specifically for logging various steps and events during the process.

methods.name: LogPeriodicallyInvokeProtocol
methods.description: Logs the initiation of periodic exchange protocol with specified timing parameters.

methods.name: LogSingleSiloCluster
methods.description: Logs a message indicating that activation repartitioning is waiting for additional silos in the cluster.

methods.name: LogExchangeSetIsEmpty
methods.description: Logs when the exchange set for a candidate silo is empty, prompting trying the next candidate.

methods.name: LogBeginningProtocol
methods.description: Logs the start of an exchange protocol between two silos.

methods.name: LogExchangedRecently
methods.description: Logs when an exchange request is rejected due to recent involvement in another exchange.

methods.name: LogExchangedRecentlyResponse
methods.description: Logs response when an exchange request is rejected because of recent exchange activity.

methods.name: LogMutualExchangeAttempt
methods.description: Logs when an exchange request is rejected because an exchange with that host already exists.

methods.name: LogMutualExchangeAttemptResponse
methods.description: Logs when an exchange request is superseded by a mutual exchange attempt.

methods.name: LogProtocolFinalized
methods.description: Logs details of the finalization of an exchange protocol, including activations migrated.

methods.name: LogProtocolFinalizedTrace
methods.description: Trace-level log for detailed content of activated grains exchanged.

methods.name: LogErrorOnProtocolExecution
methods.description: Logs errors encountered during exchange protocol execution.

methods.name: LogErrorOnMigratingActivations
methods.description: Logs errors during migration of activation sets.

methods.name: LogReceivedExchangeRequest
methods.description: Logs receipt of an acceptance exchange request with activation set details.

methods.name: LogImbalance
methods.description: Logs the imbalance metric between remote and local activation counts.

methods.name: LogTransferSetComputed
methods.description: Logs time taken to compute transfer set and the anticipated imbalance after transfer.

methods.name: LogErrorAcceptingExchangeRequest
methods.description: Logs errors encountered when accepting an exchange request.

methods.name: LogCoolingDown
methods.description: Logs cooldown duration before starting the exchange protocol.

methods.name: LogAddingAnchoredGrains
methods.description: Logs addition of newly anchored grains for a particular silo.

methods.name: LogComputedCandidateSets
methods.description: Logs the time taken to compute candidate sets for exchange.

methods.name: LogComputedCandidateHeaps
methods.description: Logs the time taken to compute candidate heaps.
